items.reason: Creating AuthzClient first does not force its minimal provider: common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:56-57 selects by descending priority, and DefaultCryptoProvider.java:83-84 assigns 200 versus AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:70-71's 100. Furthermore, quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/KeycloakRecorder.java:210-215 explicitly sets the server provider through CryptoIntegration.setProvider, which unconditionally replaces the singleton at common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:96-98, contradicting the claimed permanent lock-in.
